extracted.name: Hwachae (Korean watermelon punch)
extracted.description: Cool down in summer with this traditional Korean dessert, a kind of fruit salad made with watermelon, ice, lemonade and blueberries
ingredient_lines: 1 apple cored and cut into 1cm cubes
instruction_lines: Remove the rind from the watermelon and cut it into 2cm bite-sized cubes.
Put ¼ of the watermelon into a food processor, blitz to a juice, then pour into a bowl and mix with the lemonade.
Add a handful of ice, the apples, frozen blueberries and watermelon pieces. Serve immediately ladled into small bowls.
